integrity: Explicit finite tests supplement, but do not substitute for, the complete structural proof; related prior polynomial-gap run counts are credited without a newness claim.
scientific_limitations: The formula applies to circular no-sentinel BWT for strictly increasing positive zero gaps and specified adjacent boundary; a direct gap-order proof establishes all lengths. Nonmonotone gaps, sentinel variants and independent validation are not covered.
title: Exact circular Burrows–Wheeler transforms of increasing-gap binary words
